title: Not Guilty
question: What was the Customs Officer looking for?

meanings.usage: 既可以指人犯了罪，也可以指人因为做错事而感到愧疚
常搭配介词towards/of，表示对某事物/某人宽容
海关场景中特指申报需缴税的物品，也可用于正式宣布决定、消息等

meanings.meaning: 老练的；有经验的； hardened的动词harden意为变硬
meanings.usage: 常修饰有多年不良经历、已经习以为常的人，如hardened criminal（惯犯）
对应动词smuggle，意为走私、偷运

meanings.meaning: 爱指手画脚的，好管闲事的
meanings.usage: 多含贬义，形容人过度行使权力、多管闲事
修饰动词，表示做某事时的状态很自信，对应形容词confident
口语中常用来形容事物质量差、情况很糟糕
常搭配介词on/upon，指突然抓住机会或者扑向某物/某人
修饰说话的语气，对应形容词sarcastic
常搭配介词from，表示免除某项义务、税费等
海关场景中特指进口/出口关税，常见搭配import duty（进口税）
这里hair gel指发胶，也可作动词表示胶凝、成型
前缀un-表示反义，对应动词screw（拧紧）
通常用复数形式nostrils表示两个鼻孔

phrases.usage: 海关场景专有名词，指无需申报物品的旅客通行的“绿色通道”

examples.en: If you have nothing to declare, you can take the Green Channel.
examples.zh: 如果你没有需要申报的物品，你可以走绿色通道。

phrases.usage: 表示直视某人的眼睛，通常用于坦诚、问心无愧的场景

examples.en: He lied to me and couldn't look me in the eye when he spoke.
examples.zh: 他对我撒了谎，说话的时候不敢直视我的眼睛。

phrases.usage: 此处含义是“仔细检查”，还有“经历、度过”的含义

examples.en: The police went through all the evidence to find the truth.
examples.zh: 警方仔细检查了所有证据来找出真相。

phrases.usage: 形容东西乱作一团，或者情况非常糟糕

examples.en: After the party, the whole house was in a dreadful mess.
examples.zh: 派对结束后，整栋房子乱得一塌糊涂。

phrases.usage: 此处指“（脸上）流露出喜悦、兴奋的神情”，还有“点亮、开灯”的含义

examples.en: Her face lit up when she received the admission letter.
examples.zh: 收到录取通知书的时候，她脸上露出了喜色。

phrases.usage: 指猛抓住某物，或者突然指出别人的错误、抓住机会

examples.en: The reporter pounced on the politician's slip of the tongue.
examples.zh: 记者立刻抓住了政客的口误进行追问。

phrases.usage: 表示免除某责任、义务或费用

examples.en: Students are exempt from the entrance fee for the museum.
examples.zh: 学生可以免除这家博物馆的门票费用。

phrases.usage: 专有名词，指进口商品需要缴纳的进口税

examples.en: You have to pay import duty on luxury goods brought from abroad.
examples.zh: 你从国外带回的奢侈品需要缴纳进口税。

sentences.en: Customs Officers are quite tolerant these days, but they can still stop you when you are going through the Green Channel and have nothing to declare.
sentences.zh: 如今海关官员相当宽容，但当你走绿色通道并且没有东西要申报时，他们仍然可以拦住你。

sentences.en: Even really honest people are often made to feel guilty.
sentences.zh: 即使是非常诚实的人也常常会感到内疚。

sentences.en: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，那些老练的职业走私犯从不会被这种感觉所困扰，

sentences.en: even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
sentences.zh: 即使他的手提箱里藏着五百块金表。

sentences.en: When I returned from abroad recently, a particularly officious young Customs Officer
sentences.zh: 最近我从国外回来时，一位特别爱管闲事的年轻海关官员

sentences.en: clearly regarded me as a smuggler.
sentences.zh: 显然把我当成了走私犯。

sentences.en: 'Have you anything to declare?' he asked, looking me in the eye.
sentences.zh: “你有什么要申报的吗？”他直视着我的眼睛问道。

sentences.en: 'No,' I answered confidently.
sentences.zh: “没有，”我自信地回答道。

sentences.en: 'Would you mind unlocking this suitcase please? '
sentences.zh: “请您打开这个手提箱好吗？”

sentences.en: 'Not at all,' I answered.
sentences.zh: “当然可以，”我回答道。

sentences.en: The Officer went through the case with great care.
sentences.zh: 那个官员非常仔细地检查了箱子。

sentences.en: All the things I had packed so carefully were soon in a dreadful mess.
sentences.zh: 我费尽心思整理好的所有东西很快就乱七八糟了。

sentences.en: I felt sure I would never be able to close the case again.
sentences.zh: 我确信我再也无法把箱子合上了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, I saw the Officer's face light up.
sentences.zh: 突然，我看到那个官员的脸上露出了喜色。

sentences.en: He had spotted a tiny bottle at the bottom of my case
sentences.zh: 他发现了一个小瓶子在我的箱子底部

sentences.en: and he pounced on it with delight.
sentences.zh: 他欣喜若狂地扑了上去。

sentences.en: 'Perfume, eh?' he asked sarcastically.
sentences.zh: “香水，嗯？”他挖苦地问道。

sentences.en: 'You should have declared that.
sentences.zh: “你应该申报那个。

sentences.en: Perfume is not exempt from import duty. '
sentences.zh: 香水不免除进口关税。”

sentences.en: 'But it isn't perfume,' I said. 'It's hair gel.'
sentences.zh: “但它不是香水，”我说，“它是发胶。”

sentences.en: Then I added with a smile,
sentences.zh: 然后我笑着补充道，

sentences.en: 'It's a strange mixture I make myself.
sentences.zh: “这是我自己调制的一种奇怪的混合物。”

sentences.en: As I expected, he did not believe me.
sentences.zh: 如我所料，他没有相信我。

sentences.en: 'Try it!' I said encouragingly.
sentences.zh: “尝尝看！”我鼓励地说。

sentences.en: The Officer unscrewed the cap and put the bottle to his nostrils.
sentences.zh: 那个官员拧开瓶盖，把瓶子凑到鼻孔前。

sentences.en: He was greeted by an unpleasant smell which convinced him that I was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 一股难闻的气味扑鼻而来，这让他相信我说的是实话。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, I was able to hurry away with precious chalk marks on my baggage.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，我带着行李上珍贵的粉笔标记，匆匆离开了。

exercises.explain: gel · /dʒel/ · noun · 凝胶，胶冻。这里hair gel指发胶，也可作动词表示胶凝、成型

exercises.prompt: “过去分词可以放在名词前面或后面作定语，表被动或者完成的含义” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 及物动词过去分词 + 名词 / 名词 + 过去分词（短语）
options: no matter what引导的让步状语从句
Not only...but (also) 引起的倒装句
exercises.explain: 过去分词作定语：及物动词过去分词 + 名词 / 名词 + 过去分词（短语）：单个过去分词一般放在被修饰名词前，过去分词短语作定语则放在被修饰名词后，相当于一个被动语态的定语从句

grammar.title: should have done 结构
grammar.definition: 表示“本应该做某事（实际上没做）”，属于虚拟语气的一种，常用来表达责备、后悔、建议等语气
grammar.structure: should + have + 动词过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于谈论过去本该发生却没有发生的情况，否定形式为should not have done，表“本不该做某事却做了”

examples.en: You should have declared that.
examples.zh: 你本应该申报那个（物品）的。

examples.en: You should have told me the news earlier.
examples.zh: 你本应该早点告诉我这个消息的。

examples.en: We shouldn't have spent so much money on unnecessary things.
examples.zh: 我们本不该在不必要的东西上花这么多钱的。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语
grammar.definition: 过去分词可以放在名词前面或后面作定语，表被动或者完成的含义
grammar.structure: 及物动词过去分词 + 名词 / 名词 + 过去分词（短语）
grammar.usage: 单个过去分词一般放在被修饰名词前，过去分词短语作定语则放在被修饰名词后，相当于一个被动语态的定语从句

examples.en: even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
examples.zh: 即便他的手提箱里藏着500块金表。

examples.en: The book written by my favorite author sold very well.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的作家写的那本书销量非常好。

examples.en: We need to fix the broken window before it rains.
examples.zh: 下雨前我们得把那扇碎了的窗户修好。

original.en: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings.
original.zh: 而另一方面，老练的职业走私犯却从来不会被这种情绪困扰。

examples.en: Many people enjoy living in big cities. Small towns, on the other hand, are more suitable for people who love quiet life.
examples.zh: 很多人喜欢在大城市生活，而另一方面，小城镇更适合喜爱安静生活的人。

examples.en: Online learning is very convenient. Traditional classroom education, on the other hand, allows better interaction between teachers and students.
examples.zh: 线上学习非常方便，而另一方面，传统课堂教育能让师生有更好的互动。

patterns.pattern: Would you mind doing sth please?

original.en: Would you mind unlocking this suitcase please?
original.zh: 麻烦你打开这个手提箱好吗？

examples.en: Would you mind passing me the salt on the table please?
examples.zh: 麻烦你把桌子上的盐递给我好吗？

examples.en: Would you mind turning down the radio a little? I'm doing my homework.
examples.zh: 麻烦你把收音机音量调小一点可以吗？我正在做作业。

original.en: He was greeted by an unpleasant smell which convinced him that I was telling the truth.
original.zh: 一股难闻的气味扑面而来，让他相信我说的是实话。

examples.en: When I opened the door of the bakery, I was greeted by the warm smell of fresh bread.
examples.zh: 我打开面包店的门时，扑面而来的是新鲜面包温暖的香气。

examples.en: The visitors were greeted by the beautiful song of birds as they walked into the forest.
examples.zh: 游客们走进森林时，耳边首先传来了鸟儿动听的歌声。
